sources.title: GitHub - vllm-project/semantic-router: A programmable Mixture-of-Models ...
sources.snippet: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select—or compose—the right model path for each request. Use it to improve quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic into applications.
